cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：不管怎样
cards.example_zh: 不管怎样，我们准时到了。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: His arrow hit the centre of the target in PE.
cards.example_zh: 体育课上，他射出的箭正中靶心。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：问；询问
cards.example_en: Ask the driver which stop is closest to the museum.
cards.example_zh: 问问司机，哪一站离博物馆最近。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: The baker made a fresh batch of biscuits.
cards.example_zh: 面包师做了一批新鲜饼干。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：此外；除了

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: She writes a travel blog about weekend trips.
cards.example_zh: 她写一个旅行博客，记录周末的出行。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: The museum displayed an old bomb from the war.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆展出了一枚战争时期的旧炸弹。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: Farmers breed sheep on the green hills near town.
cards.example_zh: 农民在城镇附近的青山上饲养绵羊。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：打电话；叫
cards.example_en: I will call my grandma after I get home.
cards.example_zh: 我到家以后会给奶奶打电话。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: Dad brought his camera to the school sports day.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸带上相机来参加学校运动会。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: My friends and I chat on the bus ride home.
cards.example_zh: 我和朋友们在回家的公交车上聊天。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: The children climb the hill behind our school.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们爬学校后面的那座小山。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: Parents made a firm demand for a zebra crossing outside the gate.
cards.example_zh: 家长们坚决要求在校门外画一条斑马线。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: Long division was the difficulty that stopped most of the class.
cards.example_zh: 长除法是拦住班上大多数人的难点。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：电子邮件
cards.example_en: I'll send you an email with the details.
cards.example_zh: 我会向您发送一封包含详细信息的电子邮件。
